It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

== History ==
Its founding period is unknown<ref name=":0">''{{ill|Kadokawa Nihon Chimei Daijiten|ja|角川日本地名大辞典|ko|가도카와 일본 지명 대사전|ru|Большой словарь японских топонимов Кадокава|uk|Великий словник японських топонімів Кадокава|zh|角川日本地名大辭典|qid=Q4093011}} 36 Tokushima Prefecture'' ({{ill|1986|ab|1986|af|1986|als|1986|am|1986 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1986|ar|1986|ary|1986|arz|1986|ast|1986|av|1986 сон|avk|1986|az|1986|azb|۱۹۸۶ (میلادی)|ba|1986 йыл|ban|1986|bar|1986|bat_smg|1986|bcl|1986|be|1986|be_x_old|1986|bg|1986|bh|1986|bjn|1986|bn|১৯৮৬|bo|༡༩༨༦ལོ།|bpy|মারি ১৯৮৬|br|1986|bs|1986.|ca|1986|cdo|1986 nièng|ce|1986 шо|ceb|1986|ckb|١٩٨٦|co|1986|crh|1986|cs|1986|csb|1986|cv|1986|cy|1986|da|1986|de|1986|diq|1986|el|1986|eml|1986|eo|1986|es|1986|et|1986|eu|1986|fa|۱۹۸۶|fi|1986|fiu_vro|1986|fo|1986|fr|1986|frp|1986|frr|1986|fur|1986|fy|1986|ga|1986|gag|1986|gan|1986年|gcr|1986|gd|1986|gl|1986|gn|1986|gv|1986|ha|1986|hak|1986-ngièn|he|1986|hi|१९८६|hif|1986|hr|1986.|hsb|1986|ht|1986 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1986|hy|1986|hyw|1986 թուական|ia|1986|id|1986|ilo|1986|inh|1986 шу|io|1986|is|1986|it|1986|ja|1986年|jbo|1986moi|jv|1986|ka|1986|kaa|1986|kbp|1986|kk|1986 жыл|kn|೧೯೮೬|ko|1986년|krc|1986 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1986|ku|1986|kv|1986-ӧд во|kw|1986|la|1986|lb|1986|lez|1986 йис|li|1986|lij|1986|lmo|1986|ln|1986|lt|1986 m.|lv|1986. gads|mai|१९८६|map_bms|1986|mdf|1986|mg|1986|mhr|1986|mi|1986|min|1986|mk|1986|ml|1986|mn|1986 он|mr|इ.स. १९८६|mrj|1986 и|ms|1986|my|၁၉၈၆|myv|1986 ие|mzn|۱۹۸۶|nah|1986|nap|1986|nds|1986|nds_nl|1986|nl|1986|nn|1986|no|1986|nov|1986|nrm|1986|nso|1986|oc|1986|olo|1986|or|୧୯୮୬|os|1986-æм аз|pa|1986|pag|1986|pam|1986|pap|1986|pl|1986|pnb|1986|pt|1986|qu|1986|ro|1986|roa_tara|1986|ru|1986 год|rue|1986|sah|1986 сыл|sc|1986|scn|1986|sd|1986ع|se|1986|sh|1986.|shn|1986|si|1986|simple|1986|sk|1986|sl|1986|smn|1986|so|1986|sq|1986|sr|1986|stq|1986|su|1986|sv|1986|sw|1986|szl|1986|ta|1986|te|1986|tg|Соли 1986|th|พ.ศ. 2529|tk|1986|tl|1986|tly|1986|tpi|1986|tr|1986|tt|1986 ел|ty|1986|udm|1986 ар|ug|1986 - يىلى|uk|1986|ur|1986ء|uz|1986|vec|1986|vi|1986|vls|1986|vo|1986|wa|1986|war|1986|wuu|1986年|xmf|1986|yi|1986|za|1986 nienz|zea|1986|zh|1986年|zh_classical|一九八六年|zh_min_nan|1986 nî|zh_yue|1986年|zu|1986|qid=Q2430}} ISBN 4040013603)</ref>. Up to {{ill|1875|Q7764|qid=Q7764}} (Meiji 8), it was called Sugiō Daimyōjin, and there is a theory that {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|Q272993|qid=Q272993|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto}} was its deity<ref name=":0" />.

It is said that on the lunar date of March 10 in {{ill|1184|Q19728|qid=Q19728}} (Genryaku 1), {{ill|Minamoto no Yoshitsune|Q310445|qid=Q310445}} worshipped here while heading for {{ill|Yashima|Q11465681|qid=Q11465681}}<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{ill|2000|Q1985|qid=Q1985}}, {{ill|Heibonsha|Q11482108|qid=Q11482108}}, ''Place Names of Tokushima Prefecture''</ref>.

== Access ==
* About 15 minutes on foot from {{ill|Jizōbashi Station|Q6203576|qid=Q6203576}} on the {{ill|Mugi Line|Q860478|qid=Q860478}} of {{ill|Shikoku Railway Company|Q496531|qid=Q496531|lt=JR}}.
* About 20 minutes by car from {{ill|Tokushima interchange|Q11071632|qid=Q11071632}} on the {{ill|Tokushima Expressway|Q11490216|qid=Q11490216}}.
